name: aggregates
description: The toolkit's default for a register-research project's aggregate results, in long form: person counts, means, quantiles and regression coefficients by groups. A file the project does not use is written with zero rows. Published counts are perturbed by the pipeline with the cell key method; a share is published as one count per outcome category, never as a ratio. Each statistic rests on a check-only true person count (n_true), which the gate tests and never exports. Gate 0.6.0.

files.name: counts.parquet
files.description: Persons per cell, cell-key perturbed. table names the output (a table or figure in the paper); year and group_1 to group_3 are its keys, null where a table has fewer. A share is two or more rows, one per outcome category.

files.name: statistics.parquet
files.description: One mean-type statistic per row (a mean or a standard deviation of a variable), never a quantile, an extreme or a ratio of a binary variable. statistic names it, for example mean_income. n_persons is the cell-key perturbed count; n_true the true distinct persons, check-only.

files.name: quantiles.parquet
files.description: Fixed quantiles of one variable per row. A quantile is one person's value unless at least 5 persons lie on each side of it, so each column's minimum support is 5 divided by its smaller tail: 50 for p10 and p90, 20 for p25 and p75, 10 for the median.

files.name: coefficients.parquet
files.description: One regression term per row. n_true is the estimation sample's true distinct persons and k_true the true persons the term singles out (for a dummy, those with value 1; for an intercept or a continuous term, all of n_true), both check-only. n_persons and n_obs (rows, person-years say) are published.
